answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply groups problems as 'Fix first (these send people to the gate with a booking that won't work)', 'Fix next' and 'Smaller fixes', and gives the order '1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 ... then 6 → 7 → 8 → 9 → 10'. It also says it 'couldn't open the site in a browser' and asks for the top items to be checked 'on a real phone (360 px wide, dark mode, VoiceOver/TalkBack)', and for the no-server question to be checked with the agency.

mapping.title: Bundle sends nothing to a server, slot data invented, 'today' fixed at 12 October (reads like a demo)
mapping.reason: This is about the delivered build being a demo fixture, and the review itself says to confirm it with the agency and reviews the flow as designed. It is not a usability or accessibility problem residents meet in the booking flow.

mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking, and nothing shows the first tap worked
mapping.reason: This is the same problem: no visible progress on Book, a second press within 1.5 s cancels, and the done page still says 'Booked' with a reference.

mapping.title: The 5-minute hold runs out silently, with a misleading message and the slot blanked
mapping.reason: This matches the defect: the hold is never shown, and on expiry Book says 'This slot is no longer available' and the slot line becomes a dash.

mapping.title: Today's slots inside the cut-off look free and are refused only after Book
mapping.reason: Today's started or soon-starting slots (08:00–10:20 at 10:05) can be chosen and are refused at the end with no link, which is exactly the defect.

mapping.title: Van and trailer permit: rule behind an icon, field appears 1.2 s late, checked only after Book
mapping.reason: It covers the permit rule behind the info icon, the delayed permit field, Next accepting an empty permit, and enforcement on the confirm page with no way back to the field. These are all parts of D07.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' and 'Back to the slots' forget the chosen day
mapping.reason: The first step always reopens on Today and ignores the saved day and slot, which is the 'Change slot' defect.

mapping.title: Slot buttons show no focus outline
mapping.reason: The injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' removes the focus ring from the slots only, which is the defect.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved out of time order, so reading and Tab order differ from what is on screen
mapping.reason: The CSS order:-1 on 'Few left' slots puts them ahead of the headings and breaks the visual order against the focus and reading order. That is D10.

mapping.title: Slot grid overflows sideways at 360 px and below
mapping.reason: The script fixes column widths from the window width at 360 px or less, the right column is cut off and the page scrolls sideways. This is the same defect.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag has low contrast in both themes
mapping.reason: The amber 'Few left' tag falls below 4.5:1 in the light and dark themes, which is the contrast defect.

mapping.title: Done page shows no day, time or vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page gives only the reference, with no day, time window or vehicle, which is exactly D14.

mapping.title: The 20-minute arrival rule is only in a hover tooltip
mapping.reason: The slot length and arrival window are only in the button's title tooltip, which phones never show. This is D13.

mapping.title: Done page would show the placeholder reference 'DR-000000' if the reference is missing
mapping.reason: The review raises this only as a code-level edge case. It shows no path by which a resident who books would reach a done page without a reference, so it is speculative.

mapping.title: Slots vanish for about 0.9 s with no loading message, and Next does nothing meanwhile
mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: the grid is empty with nothing saying slots are coming, and Next gives no response.

mapping.title: 'N slots free' status gets aria-live only after its first message
mapping.reason: The status line becomes a live region too late, so the first slot count is never announced. This is D11.

mapping.title: Error-summary links point to the #vehicle and #waste containers, not to controls
mapping.reason: A keyboard or screen-reader resident who follows the error link lands on a container rather than the radio or checkbox they must fix, so they have to search for the control. This is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Vehicle choice uses aria-pressed toggle buttons rather than radio buttons
mapping.reason: Toggle buttons with aria-pressed still announce which vehicle is chosen. Preferring radios is a pattern preference, and the review shows no resident failing because of it.

mapping.title: Vehicle error is not programmatically connected to the vehicle group
mapping.reason: A screen-reader user who moves to the vehicle buttons is not told what is wrong with them, so they may not be able to correct the error. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: On the waste checkboxes the error replaces the 'Rubble up to four bags' hint for screen readers
mapping.reason: A screen-reader resident with an error loses the hint about waste limits just when they need it to choose correctly. This is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Registration and postcode fields lack autocapitalize='characters' and spellcheck='false'
mapping.reason: Most residents book on a phone, where autocorrect and lower-casing can garble a registration or postcode. A booking that does not match the vehicle can be refused at the gate. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking; the phone line is only open weekdays 09:00–17:00
mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening and, per the review, changing a booking is a top task in the brief, yet the only route is a daytime phone line. This is a genuine barrier and is not in the ground truth.
